summary: First-finish smoke test of condo association app. Backend auth + all major CRUD/business endpoints (units, fees, expenses, budget, vendors, communications, compliance, reports) verified via API. Frontend e2e: login -> units -> fees -> expenses -> budget -> compliance -> reports -> logout all working. Idempotency for fees/generate and compliance/seed confirmed. paid_date auto-set on PUT /api/fees/{id}. budget/generate-from-prior aggregates prior-year expenses with uplift.
passed: GET /api/dashboard/summary?year=YYYY returns all expected fields (ytd_income, ytd_expenses, balance_ytd, overdue_count, overdue_amount, units_count, expenses_by_category, monthly[12])
PUT /api/fees/{id} with paid=true auto-sets paid_date and updates method/notes/amount_paid
POST /api/expenses creates expense; GET filters by year
POST /api/budget/generate-from-prior with uplift_pct=5 produced 2027 BudgetItem ($525 from $500)
POST /api/compliance/seed first=13 tasks, second=0 (idempotent); returns IL_NFP, IRS, Internal categories
GET /api/reports/annual returns association_name, summary, expenses, fees, budget, generated_at, year
Frontend login flow with data-testid login-email/password/submit
Sidebar nav (nav-units, nav-fees, nav-expenses, nav-budget, nav-compliance, nav-reports) all navigate
Annual Report page renders financial summary with correct Income ($250), Expenses ($500), Net Balance (-$250) and monthly table
logout-button clears cookie and redirects to /login
